source: PreflightGateEvaluator #105 and CoordinationLockHealthAudit #107 are integrated; missing file-system runner that composes them against a machine checklist and live lock directory.
objective: Add a read-only CLI/library runner that loads a preflight JSON, validates the live lock registry, maps task states by task_id, applies optional explicit overrides, evaluates effective gates and emits a deterministic go/no-go report without modifying checklist, locks or roadmap.

coordination.dependencies: Consumes PreflightGateEvaluator and audit-lock-health public APIs read-only.
coordination.agent_d: RendererAdapter scope remains under dev/framework/wiz/data-wiz-* and is disjoint.
